articles.summary: Single- and two-story floor plans from the mid $200s bring attainable new homes to Spartanburg County KEY TAKEAWAYS Affordable New Homes: Century Complete is now selling new single-family homes at Hudson Village in Cowpens, South Carolina. Starting from $231,888, the community's new homes put homeownership within reach in Spartanburg County. Five Floor Plans: New homes at Hudson Village range from 1,155 to 1,965 square feet with 3 to 4 bedrooms. Included Features: Every home includes quartz countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and 36" Shaker cabinets. Spartanburg Access: Hudson Village sits minutes from I-85, with Spartanburg 10 to 15 minutes away, plus access to Greenville and Charlotte, N.C. Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—today announced that its Century Complete brand is now selling new homes at Hudson Village, a single-family home community
articles.title: Century Complete Now Selling New Homes at Hudson Village in Cowpens, South Carolina

articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS), a leading national homebuilder, today announced that the Company will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. A conference call will be held that same day at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time, 3:00 p.m. Mountain time, to review the Company's third quarter results, discuss recent events and conduct a question-and-answer session. Webcast: The conference call will be available in the Investors section of the Company's website at www.centurycommunities.com . To listen to a live broadcast, go to the site at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled start time in order to register, download and install any necessary audio software.
